description: 충청북도 괴산군_일방통행도로 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도 괴산군. 충청북도 괴산군 일방통행도로 시도명, 시군구명, 도로명, 지정사유, 지정연도, 도로폭, 도로연장, 차로수, 보차분리여부, 기관명 등을 제공하는 서비스. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
